Name: Methyl Mercaptan
Description: Representative light mercaptan in sour refinery streams.

Name: Dimethyl Disulfide
Description: Disulfide formed by sweetening methyl mercaptan.

Name: Sweetened Naphtha
Description: Naphtha whose mercaptans have been oxidized to disulfides.

Name: Sweetened Kerosene
Description: Kerosene whose mercaptans have been oxidized to disulfides.
